neon-night.text: It's official — #NeonNight is happening. Grab your leg warmers, we're throwing back to the 80s for Hoboken Homeless Home. Mark your calendars.
Registration is open! Every ticket goes straight to warm beds and hot meals this winter. Link in bio — let’s pack the park.
Huge thanks to the volunteer crew who spent their Saturday stringing lights and testing the sound system. Prospect Park is going to glow.
Two days until #NeonNight! The synth playlist is locked, the disco ball is hung, and we’ve already got 200+ backers. Let’s make some noise for Hoboken Homeless Home.
WE ARE LIVE. Doors are open and Prospect Park already looks like 1985 threw up glitter everywhere. Let’s go!
Just donated $75 — this room’s energy is unmatched tonight!
The dance floor filled up faster than I expected. This crowd showed UP for Hoboken Homeless Home tonight.
Thank you Hoboken for showing up in your finest neon. Every dollar tonight keeps our shelter beds full this winter.
neon-night.author: nonprofit

neon-night.text: Halfway there and we just crossed $10,000 raised. That’s warm beds for the whole winter. Keep it coming.
Costume contest was a DISASTER in the best way. Whoever came as Molly Ringwald, please collect your prize.
Last call for donations before the final song — let’s see if we can hit $14K before the lights come up.
Final numbers going up on the board now. This room raised more than I hoped for in my wildest 80s dreams.
That’s a wrap on #NeonNight. Prospect Park, you partied for the people and it showed. Thank you doesn’t cover it.
Final tally: $14,280 raised and 213 backers strong. Every dollar goes to Hoboken Homeless Home’s winter shelter program. You all are the real MVPs.
One more look back at the best decade-themed night Brooklyn’s seen in years. Already thinking about round two.

give-now.text: Snow’s already falling on Windham and so is the countdown to #GiveNowApre’Later. Boards up, hearts open — let’s ride for Windham Mountain Conservatory.
Lift tickets + your generosity = one epic après for conservation. Registration’s live, link in bio.
Mountain crew just finished prepping the terrain park for Saturday. Windham Mountain Conservatory, we’re bringing the whole hill out for you.
Boards strapped in — #GiveNowApre’Later is officially live on the mountain!
First run of the day and the energy on this hill is unreal.
Just donated $60 — first run of the season and already raising for the mountain I love.
Après tent is packed and the hot cocoa is flowing. Keep the donations coming for Windham Mountain Conservatory.
We just watched someone attempt a backflip for charity. Bold. Respected.
$5K raised and counting — this mountain shows up every single year.
Every donation today funds trail and habitat restoration on this mountain. Thank you for riding for us.
give-now.author: nonprofit

give-now.text: Sunset run incoming. Just wanted to say — this community is unreal.
Final lift of the day and the leaderboard for top fundraisers is locked in.
That’s a wrap on #GiveNowApre’Later — sore legs, full hearts. Thank you Windham Mountain.
$5,400 raised for Windham Mountain Conservatory. Every dollar protects the trails we shredded yesterday.

golf-outing.text: Tee times are set — #CharityHubGolfOuting is on for Westchester. Bring your good times to the course, may the best shooter win, and let’s fund some sight-restoring surgeries.
Course crew mowed every fairway twice this week. Center For Sight Restoration, we’re ready for you.
First tee-off of the day! #CharityHubGolfOuting is live in Westchester.
Just donated $100 — my dad had his sight restored by this team, so this one’s personal.
Turn at the 9th and the leaderboard is already chaos. Love to see it.
Every swing today is funding a sight-restoring surgery for someone who needs it. Thank you, golfers.
golf-outing.author: nonprofit

golf-outing.text: Closest-to-the-pin contest just raised another $800 for Center For Sight Restoration on its own.
Clubs are packed up and #CharityHubGolfOuting raised $6,800 for Center For Sight Restoration. Not bad for a Saturday.
Last look back at a beautiful day on the course — thank you to every golfer who showed up and swung for a good cause.

dog-dad.text: Calling all Dog Dads — #DogDads is coming to Central Park and it’s time to give some street cred to the good boys who stepped up. Registration open now.
Bergen County Rescue Shelter just sent over the list of pups still looking for their person. Bring your dog, bring your wallet, bring your heart.
Central Park is FULL of dogs and their proud dads. #DogDads is live!
Best dressed dog contest happening right now and I am not okay with how good these costumes are.
Just donated $50 in honor of my rescue pup Biscuit. Adopt, don’t shop.
Every Dog Dad here today is the reason we can keep rescuing. Thank you for showing up.
dog-dad.author: nonprofit

dog-dad.text: We just passed $3,000 raised for Bergen County Rescue Shelter. These dogs did that.
Last lap around the park before we wrap — thank you to every dad who showed up today.
That’s a wrap on #DogDads. $3,200 raised and (unofficially) 40 new best friends made.
Bergen County Rescue Shelter just told us three dogs from today got adopted this week. That’s the whole point right there.

breakneck-ridge-run.text: Registration for #BreakneckRidgeRun is open. Don’t give up and don’t break your neck — let’s raise some serious trail-maintenance money for Hudson Valley Trail Society.
Trail crew just cleared the last stretch near the summit. Breakneck Ridge is ready for all of you.
Tomorrow’s the day. Pack your water, tape your ankles, and get ready to climb for Hudson Valley Trail Society.
Runners are off! #BreakneckRidgeRun is officially underway.
First finishers cresting the summit and the views (and donations) are incredible today.
Just donated $60 — these trails saved my sanity this year, happy to give back.
We just crossed $8,000 raised — every mile today is funding trail repairs for next season.
Every runner today is funding real trail repairs for next season. Thank you for climbing for us.
breakneck-ridge-run.author: nonprofit

breakneck-ridge-run.text: Last runners coming down the ridge. What a day for Hudson Valley Trail Society.
That’s a wrap on #BreakneckRidgeRun — $8,920 raised and a whole lot of sore quads. Thank you.
Final gallery from the ridge is up. This trail, and this community, never disappoints.
